prompt_template:
Create a professional social media thumbnail image for {{platform}}.

{{thumbnail_prompt}}

IMPORTANT TEXT OVERLAY: Render the following words as very large, bold, dominant text on the thumbnail: "{{thumbnail_text}}"
The text must be clearly readable, use a bold sans-serif font (like Montserrat Black), and be the most prominent visual element alongside any person featured.

Color palette to use:
- Primary: {{primary_color}} (golden yellow-orange)
- Dark: {{dark_color}} (deep purple)
- Light background: {{light_color}} (off-white)
- Accent: {{accent_color}} (empowering pink-red)
- Soft accent: {{soft_accent_color}} (muted pink)

Style guidelines:
- High contrast, eye-catching composition
- Professional quality suitable for {{platform}}
- The text overlay must be large and readable even at small sizes
- If a person is featured, their expression should convey strong emotion matching the content
- Use the provided color palette for the design elements, text colors, and background accents
- Clean, modern design with strong visual hierarchy
